props.text:
Look man, I'm not much of a chart guy but when I do the whole charts thing, I know my shit.

We're at gold trading into yearly open + BTC/GOLD rejecting from meme resistance area. I think gold rips hard again and puts a macro HTF double bottom vs the BTC pair (before we see BTC meaningfully reverse hard — aggressively bullish).

Timeline: close to end of year.

**Key observation**: ETH.D is the REAL CHART for alts flying. In crypto history, BTC trading sideways after bottoming has meant accumulation but also money flowing into STRONG alts.

Buy before the BTC/GOLD macro bottom — ETH.D is predicting that occurrence sooner than later.
